title: Keep sequential LLM calls on their configured models
description:
As a Tactus procedure author, I want each LLM-backed call to use its own configured model and token settings, so that a procedure can combine classification and generation without one call inheriting another call's configuration.

Feature: LLM configuration isolation

Scenario: Two LLM-backed calls use separate configurations in one runtime
Given a Tactus procedure defines two LLM-backed calls with different model identifiers and token limits
When the procedure executes the calls sequentially
Then each call is invoked with its own configured model identifier
And each call is invoked with its own configured token limit
And the second call does not inherit the first call's configuration.
